scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute (T1) infeasible in verifier sandbox; scoring structural relationships (adsorption weakening, lattice expansion) and numeric closeness to paper-reported values with tolerances to verify reproduction.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide target binding energies and interlayer distances from the paper to compare agent's computed values.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (10.1021/acs.jpcc.6b12026) text: O on Pd(111) fcc -1.78 eV, O on Pd-B(111) hcp -1.36 eV, OH on Pd(111) fcc -3.07 eV, OH on Pd-B(111) bridge -2.98 eV, interlayer distances 2.282 Å and 2.335 Å.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from the paper's DFT results section and Table S3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact numbers reported by the paper; they serve as the hidden gold for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Computed binding energies and structural distances for Pd and Pd-B surfaces, to be compared against hidden reference values from the literature.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each numeric field to the paper-reported reference value within a small tolerance. The agent must produce the computed quantities from DFT, not simply look up the reported values.

steps.comment: Score based on field-level tolerance and structural trend checks.
